description: GBFS Data is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Bird. Bird makes system data owned by Bird conforming to the General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS) available on request, subject to the terms and conditions of a GBFS data license agreement - City API Data Access can be accessed through: API credentials and information can be requested via benelux@bird.co. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are gbfs. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Not specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
